finding.expected: Reuse or exactly preserve the existing canonical RUN validation semantics for every transported run.json before aggregation, including the remediation wrapper path, so a malformed RUN fails closed independently of whether observation.json exists. Keep missing observation.json as a coverage gap only after the RUN and terminal family are themselves valid canonical artifacts.
finding.issue: The performance surface does not fully validate transported canonical run.json before treating a terminal as a valid snapshot member. It manually checks only run_id, task, positive revision, non-empty executor/base_sha and ACTIVE status; it does not enforce the canonical Run contract for fields such as supported executor identity and non-empty workspace. When observation.json is missing, such malformed RUN metadata can therefore be reported as an ordinary telemetry coverage gap instead of failing closed.
